annotations.title: Natural and industrial hazard report for a French address

description: Property risk report for a French address or GPS point: natural hazards (seismic zone, radon, clay shrink-swell, flood, ground movement, past CatNat disasters) and nearby industrial sites (ICPE, Seveso, polluted sites), with a French summary. Official Géorisques data. Give EITHER q (address, optionally with postcode / citycode) OR lat + lon. Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

citycode.description: Optional INSEE code of the commune (5 chars, Corsica 2A/2B), e.g. 75102

lat.description: Latitude WGS84, with lon, instead of q, e.g. 45.341575

lon.description: Longitude WGS84, with lat, instead of q, e.g. 5.81531

q.description: Free-text French address (3-200 chars). Give either q or lat+lon, e.g. Place de la Mairie Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse
